- [ASSISTANT_SAID] More information about Saladin Ahmed:
  - **Throne of the Crescent Moon** (2012) - A fantasy adventure set in a mythical Middle Eastern world.
  - **The Black Khan** (2019) - The second book in the Crescent City series.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] More information about Nnedi Okorafor:
  - **Who Fears Death** (2010) - Set in a post-apocalyptic Sudan, follows Onyesonwu's journey.
  - **Binti** (2015) - A novella about a Himba girl accepted into Oomza University on another planet.
